query: audit this module again — docs/reviews already holds a report on it from an earlier pass, and no source file has changed since
expected_behavior: The previous report is found and opened with a Since-last-pass table
Every still-open finding is judged again against the rules as they read now, not carried across on the strength of the earlier verdict

A finding whose verdict changes keeps its number, and the report says where it moved and why — including CC-002, whose costing is withdrawn: the previous pass rated it High as a retry button that stops working at runtime, a caller that exists nowhere in scope. It keeps its number and is re-judged as a Low-confidence question, because nothing in scope decides whether reload() is a broken refetch or a misnamed cache
A conclusion the earlier pass reached by a weaker method is redone, and a changed count is stated rather than left to match the old one
Numbering continues past the highest existing id for anything genuinely new
must_not: Reproduce the previous findings verbatim because the code did not change
Renumber a finding that is still open
Drop a re-judged finding silently instead of showing where it went
Treat an unchanged codebase as a reason to skip the seven principle areas
